**A test build, not a regular release.** It is for players whose city loads but never appears: the screen keeps
showing the city's picture from the region view, and scrolling smears it. If SCD3D11 v0.4.4 works for you, stay on
v0.4.4.

## Installing

Copy `SCD3D11.dll` into your SimCity 4 `Plugins` folder, replacing the old DLL. Keep your `SCD3D11.ini`.

## What to do

1. In `SCD3D11.ini`, set `DrawStats=on`. Start the game, load the city, wait about 10 seconds, scroll once and zoom
   once, then quit. Send `Logs\SCD3D11.log`.
2. Then add the line `ViewportClamp=on` to `SCD3D11.ini`, play again the same way, and say whether the city appears.
   Send that log as well.

`ViewportClamp=on` is an experiment: SCD3D11 then accepts drawing areas that reach past the edge of the screen the way
scvk does, instead of refusing them. It is off unless you turn it on.

## Also in this build

* After switching away from the game with Alt+Tab in exclusive fullscreen, SCD3D11 goes back to fullscreen when you
  return, instead of staying in a window.
